subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.11 published dist missing reentrancy guard - reply session initialization conflicted

question: Should OpenClaw publish a corrected stable package for the `v2026.6.11` dist/source mismatch, or leave users to move to a later beta or scheduled stable release?
rationale: Current main has the source fixes, but the unresolved user impact is in the latest stable package artifact, so this needs a release-owner decision rather than another source-only bugfix PR.

options.title: Publish corrected stable package
options.body: Ship a stable patch package with source/dist parity and package smoke proof so users on `latest` stop hitting the message-loss failure.

options.title: Wait for next scheduled stable
options.body: Document `v2026.6.11` as affected and ask users to opt into a beta or workaround until the next stable train ships.

recommendation.title: Publish corrected stable package
recommendation.body: Ship a stable patch package with source/dist parity and package smoke proof so users on `latest` stop hitting the message-loss failure.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is now release/package parity work, and the release tag history points to this person as the clearest available release-routing candidate.
